verdict.rationale: Digits documents built-in autonomous background work: real-time auto-booking, 24/7 AI bookkeeping, and an agentic close that collects activity continuously, reconciles, and surfaces exceptions. The evidence does not show users setting up their own automations (rules, triggers, schedules); these are fixed product behaviors, and webhooks or a read-only MCP are only building blocks. missing for 10: user-configurable automation/rule builder, recurring schedule configuration for custom tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
